name: bracket
title: Bracket
description: A hand bracket down one side of a block: these paragraphs, this list, these three rows belong together. Square, curly or round, on either side, and it flips with the page direction.

a11y: Decorative: the bracket is aria-hidden and pointer-events-none. If grouping matters to everyone, group in the markup as well (a list, a <section>, a fieldset).
It lives in the block's padding, so text never runs under it; change the padding with className if you move the spine (`inset`).
Windows high contrast hides the drawing like every overlay ink.
